name: smwgraphics-the-magical-quest-starring-mickey-mouse-snowy-valley
title: The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse - Snowy Valley
description:
A very simple but snowy background from The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse, for the SNES. I decided to rerip this one, since the old version, while accurate, used two EXGFX slots. A great fit for snow levels, in general. Or maybe a sky high level.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
